rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the Senate's session of 30 September 1992 the Chamber's Ofício SGM/P nº 1.388, dated 30 September 1992 and signed by its Mesa, was read: the Chamber had resolved at its session of 29 September to authorize the Senate to institute proceedings against President Fernando Affonso Collor de Mello for crime of responsibility, by 441 votes in favour, 38 against, one abstention and 23 absences; the Senate then proceeded to elect the Special Committee.

locator.item: (*) SGM/P nº 1.388 and the President's statement after it

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-10 only. Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, sash ceremony, authorization, summons, suspension, the Vice-President's exercise, resignation, vacancy, judgment, removal and disqualification stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Vice-presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded except the Vice-President's exercise of the office, recorded as rows only.
